name: Macro-Cell Optimization
definition: An acceleration structure where a spatial partitioning grid of disjoint, closely packed macro-cells stores the range of values and maximum opacity (µmax) for contained voxels to minimize null collisions and neural network inferences.
summary: Macro-Cell Optimization accelerates volume rendering by partitioning space into macro-cells with stored opacity statistics, enabling early ray termination and adaptive step sizing to minimize expensive neural network inferences.
